description: This file provides theme management functions, exporting theme application and retrieval functions related to a dark theme, including importing theme tokens and methods from a darkTheme module.

methods.name: setTheme(themeName = "dark")
methods.description: Sets the current theme by name, supporting 'dark' as the default and only theme, returning the applied theme tokens for inline styling purposes.

methods.name: getCurrentTheme()
methods.description: Reads the current theme setting from the document's data-theme attribute; defaults to 'dark' if not set or if document is undefined.
